scope: Existing canonical Poaceae only; taxonomy evidence, not a species-card change

synonyms.name: Poa arachnifera var. glabrata Vasey ex Beal
synonyms.note: Historical variety synonym, not an independently accepted learner concept under current POWO/WCVP.

accepted_infraspecifics: No accepted infraspecific taxa listed on consulted POWO species page; do not infer that a historical variety is an independently accepted current rank.

hybrid_concept.status: Documented artificial interspecific breeding hybrids; no separate named accepted hybrid taxon asserted from POWO in this review.
hybrid_concept.evidence: Texas A&M AggieTurf explicitly identifies hybrid bluegrass as Poa arachnifera × Poa pratensis, including multiple marketed turf cultivars; peer-reviewed cultivar registration documents F1 cross and parents. Do not collapse cultivated hybrids into pure Texas bluegrass or infer an individual photo is hybrid.

identity_and_source_conflicts.subject: Existing learner photographic identity
identity_and_source_conflicts.reason: Accepted nomenclature and genuine source-labelled photos do not independently voucher every photo or establish parentage of a particular plant.

identity_and_source_conflicts.subject: Floral sex presentation across secondary authorities
identity_and_source_conflicts.reason: Texas A&M Rangelands describes male and female flowers on different plants; a USDA government-hosted 2010 grass account states male and female spikelets on same plant. Treat that latter conflict as source discrepancy; do not rewrite existing sex-based diagnosis or infer individual sex from unsupported images without authoritative flora/voucher recheck.

existing_scientific_states: PRESERVED; no PASS/FAIL/HOLD/UNRESOLVED overrides to canonical species
installation_decision: NO_NEW_CARD; existing canonical accepted species retained; synonyms are aliases; hybrid cultivars not automatically merged
